_comment: Nothing in this repo uses a claude.ai connector: Cloudflare goes through `npx wrangler` and a token, OpenAI through scripts/art.mjs. Leaving them on cost every session here 238 tool definitions and ~290,000 tokens of start-up context before any work began - about $2.40 for a single headless turn, against $0.13 and 22 tools with them off. Measured 2026-11-27; the Game Director's call the same day. Delete this file to get them back, or toggle per server with /mcp.
